name: nvgraph.sh
reason: The npm search synopsis references Matrix Market input to GPU graph tools, but no documented local-input JavaScript parser API or runnable control was verified.

name: graphbox
reason: Release 1.4.6 declares parseMtx in its public exports, but the published ESM/CJS bundles reference missing dist/experiments/evaluation/loaders/index.ts and cannot be imported. Releases 1.4.5, 1.4.4, and 1.4.0 show the same packaging failure; 1.3.0 lacks parseMtx. No runnable public API was verified.

name: ngraph.sparse-collection
reason: The documented API loads already converted graph objects; the Matrix Market text parser belongs to ngraph.serialization and is counted there.

name: matrix-parser
reason: The package parses Matrix-style URI parameters, not the NIST Matrix Market file format.

name: mtx-decompressor
reason: MTX means MicroType Express font compression for this package, not Matrix Market.

name: matrix-js-sdk
reason: The package implements the Matrix chat protocol, not Matrix Market matrices.

name: ml-sparse-matrix
reason: The package provides sparse matrix operations; no Matrix Market input API was found in its package documentation.
